# Science and Research

Skills for scientific and academic work: bioinformatics, chemistry, materials, literature search and research statistics. They give an agent the domain procedures and library knowledge a lab or research team would otherwise explain in every prompt.

**210 accepted skills · 8 repositories.** Snapshot: **2026-10-17** · Scores: **graded-v2** · [How scores work](https://skills.suedeai.ai/directory/methodology/).

[Read the score and license key](../README.md#read-a-listing). Descriptions are saved summaries or excerpts; full details and setup are on each Suede listing.
